# Surface Reconciliation — generated by tools/archaeology/surface_reconcile.py

Reconciles the Doxygen-derived public surface inventory against the Clang AST
atlas, the raw system DSO, the candidate DSO and the installed headers, for the
current system versions. Disagreements are classified and recorded, never
silently dropped.
